articleDetail.title: 10 Superfoods to Boost Your Immunity Naturally
articleDetail.subtitle: Add these nutrient-rich superfoods to your diet and strengthen your immune system to stay healthy all year round.
articleDetail.intro: A strong immune system is your body's natural defense against illnesses and infections. The good news? Nature has provided us with powerful superfoods that can help strengthen immunity and keep us energized every day. Here are 10 superfoods you should include in your daily diet.

superfoodsDetail.name: Amla (Indian Gooseberry)
superfoodsDetail.description: Amla is packed with Vitamin C and powerful antioxidants that help boost immunity, improve digestion, and promote healthy skin.
superfoodsDetail.howToEat: Eat raw, drink amla juice, or add it to smoothies.

superfoodsDetail.name: Turmeric
superfoodsDetail.description: Turmeric contains curcumin, a potent compound with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
superfoodsDetail.howToEat: Add to curries, soups, or drink with warm milk.

superfoodsDetail.name: Garlic
superfoodsDetail.description: Garlic has allicin, which helps the body fight infections and reduces the severity of colds and flu.
superfoodsDetail.howToEat: Add raw garlic to salads, soups, or cooked dishes.

superfoodsDetail.name: Ginger
superfoodsDetail.description: Ginger helps reduce inflammation, soothes sore throat, and improves overall immunity.
superfoodsDetail.howToEat: Add to tea, smoothies, or stir-fries.
